verdict.rationale: The public docs describe a single convert endpoint that takes a file or hosted URL and returns the transcript, authenticated by API key or bearer token. They also offer an async mode that pushes results to configured webhooks, and agent-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) are confirmed by probes, so the core submit-to-transcript path is self-serve. However, the evidence never documents a polling or retrieval endpoint for async jobs, and no hands-on report shows an agent completing the flow end to end. Missing for 10: a documented async job-status/result-retrieval endpoint (only webhook push is shown), explicit API-key auth setup docs in the pack, and hands-on or independent confirmation of an unattended agent run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent holding an API key can take a recording from submission to finished transcript (auth, job creation, result retrieval) from the public docs alone, with no human step in between

citations.quote: Transcribe an audio or video file.
